statement: Every 4x4 phase-covariant PPT state whose correlated block A is rank one has Schmidt number at most 2. If A=z z^* with every z_i nonzero, every p_ij>0, and all six PPT inequalities saturate p_ij*p_ji=|z_i*z_j|^2, the state is separable if and only if the directed ratios p_ij/p_ji satisfy the cycle balance condition (equivalently p_ij/p_ji=(r_i/r_j)^2 for some r_i>0). Otherwise it is PPT entangled of Schmidt number exactly 2.
SN2_construction: For A=z z^*, PPT gives q_ij=sqrt(p_ij*p_ji)>=|z_i*z_j|. Choose any perfect matching {ij,kl}. Form X with diagonal z and two rank-one 2x2 blocks, setting X_ij=t_ij*sqrt(|z_i*z_j|), X_ji=z_i*z_j/(t_ij*sqrt(|z_i*z_j|)) with t_ij^2=sqrt(p_ij/p_ji), and similarly on kl; zero products use zero offdiagonals. Then rank(X)<=2, and its phase twirl has correlated block A and matched directed populations bounded by p. Add the residual nonnegative product-diagonal terms. A discrete 4^3 phase twirl gives at most 64 rank-two projectors plus 12 unmatched or residual product terms; saturation on the matched pairs reduces the product terms to at most eight. This is a specialization of frontier-20261028-phase-state-matching-sn2-v1.json SHA256 1dd966f0a89e6c19e977528fd6ba9dbbdf7c4e98cb757ab07d437351f0fe0b68, with a direct proof here.
saturated_separability: Assume all z_i and p_ij are nonzero and p_ij*p_ji=|z_i*z_j|^2. In a hypothetical separable decomposition, phase-twirl every product atom alpha_l tensor beta_l. The resulting diagonal-amplitude vectors z_l=(alpha_li*beta_li)_i satisfy sum_l z_l z_l^*=z z^*, so each nonzero z_l is proportional to z and has all four entries nonzero. For each pair i,j, Cauchy-Schwarz for f_l=alpha_li*conjugate(beta_lj) and g_l=alpha_lj*conjugate(beta_li) is saturated because |A_ij|^2=p_ij*p_ji; therefore |f_l|/|g_l|=sqrt(p_ij/p_ji) for every nonzero atom. Writing r_i=|alpha_li|/|beta_li| gives p_ij/p_ji=(r_i/r_j)^2 and hence the cycle condition. Atoms with all diagonal amplitudes zero cannot contribute offdiagonal populations under these saturated equalities, and can be omitted. Conversely, given positive r_i obeying the ratio condition, choose |alpha_i|^2=r_i*|z_i|, |beta_i|^2=|z_i|/r_i and phases alpha_i*beta_i=z_i. Saturation and the ratio condition give |alpha_i*beta_j|^2=p_ij; the phase twirl of this single product ket is exactly rho.
explicit_example: Take A=J_4 and all p_ij=1 except p_01=p_12=p_20=2 and p_10=p_21=p_02=1/2. Then all q_ij=1 and rho is PPT; the product of ratios around 0->1->2->0 is 64, so rho is entangled. The unnormalized trace is 35/2; rho normalized by 2/35 has birank (13,10) and Schmidt number 2. An explicit rank-two seed is block diagonal on (0,1),(2,3), with all diagonal entries 1 and offdiagonal entries X_01=sqrt(2), X_10=1/sqrt(2), X_23=X_32=1. Its 64-element diagonal-phase twirl reproduces A and the four matched populations; add the eight remaining nonnegative product-diagonal terms. The 3x3 analogue with A=J_3 and directed cyclic p is discussed as a PPT-entangled PCP example by Johnston-MacLean arXiv:1807.06897v1, https://arxiv.org/html/1807.06897v1; no novelty is asserted.

exact_check.observed: Fraction/Q(sqrt2) arithmetic checks six saturated pair products, trace 35/2, cycle ratio 64, seed block determinants and matched populations. Birank follows from the displayed block structure: rank-one A plus twelve positive diagonal entries, and four positive PT singletons plus six rank-one PT blocks. The all-variable decomposition and separability iff balance are written proofs.

limits: The iff separability statement assumes rank-one A with every z_i and p_ij nonzero and saturation on all pairs; the SN2 statement needs only PPT and rank-one A. No conclusion for higher-rank correlated blocks or general 4x4 PPT states, no target witness, and no independent/formal review or novelty claim.
